product.name: Apple 87W USB-C Charger
product.full_name: Genuine 87W USB-C Power Adapter for MacBook Pro 13" / 15"
product.description: Genuine Apple power adapter (Model A1719, Apple Part No. MNF82LL/A) for MacBook Pro 15-inch (2016/2017, A1707; 2018/2019, A1990) and MacBook Pro 13-inch with Four Thunderbolt 3 ports (2016-2020). Delivers up to 87W over USB-C — this is the wattage the 15-inch MacBook Pro needs for full-speed charging, and it's also safe to use on any lower-wattage USB-C MacBook (MacBook Air, 12-inch MacBook) since those models only draw what they need. Charging cable sold separately. Wide-range 100–240V AC input for worldwide use. Original Apple unit, tested before dispatch.
compatible_models: MacBook Air 13-inch (2018 onward, USB-C, lower-wattage compatible)
